item.text:
Implemented persistent multiline task notes in commit `40478c41ee3e002e61196d2af13be5d1753a7912`.

Notes retain whitespace, line breaks, Unicode, and literal markup. Existing tasks receive empty notes; archived projects display notes read only. Verified `node --check server.js`, `/health`, and an API save/read round trip containing literal `</textarea><script>` text. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start` (`PORT` defaults to 8080; `DB_PATH` selects the SQLite file).
